ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: StopWake uses your location while a trip you started is running, to wake you before your stop.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: StopWake only needs your location while a trip you started is running. With “Always”, it can pick a trip up again if iOS closes the app on the way.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: StopWake only needs your location while a trip you started is running. With “Always”, it can pick a trip up again if iOS closes the app on the way.
ios.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Your choice decides whether ads may be personalised. Ads keep StopWake free; the trip alarm works the same either way.
